description: F02 Unicode-search ownership. Rust terminal-buffer now performs exact UTF-16 substring search over stored rows while returning end-exclusive terminal-cell coordinates through the row's validated character/cell mapping. This closes the portable UTextAdapter Unicode contract without importing ICU or conflating Host search flags/case-folding orchestration with TextBuffer ownership.

entries.notes: Rust TextBuffer searches the same stored UTF-16 content and maps match offsets through Row character/cell offsets. The Microsoft vectors therefore remain exact for repeated ASCII (0-3, 8-11), supplementary-plane mathematical b (5-6 despite a surrogate pair), and wide Japanese ネコ (12-16). Host search flags and case-folding remain a later aggregate responsibility rather than being hidden in this classification.
